title: Paired functional protection in edited human beta cells
status: Experimental framework requiring biological calibration and prospective registration; not yet an executable confirmatory protocol
primary_candidate: RNLS as an information-rich test, not an established effective edit
product: One specified glucose-responsive human beta-cell product; independent target sources, edited preparations and batches
genetic_conditions: rescue or independent perturbation for on-target attribution
challenge_qualification: Demonstrated regulated-output injury or cell loss in controls; functional injury without cell loss is eligible. Avoid an immediately destructive challenge with no informative range.
allocation: Block by target-cell source and batch; randomize matched aliquots within blocks; cross immune donors where feasible; prespecify blinding
unit: Independently prepared and assigned product aliquot or graft; repeated times and technical wells do not create independent biological samples
initial_dose: Live beta-cell abundance at onset of challenge; match and record N0; report manufacturing yield and failures separately
paired_measurements: absolute basal secretion rate QL with prespecified acceptable range or ceiling
viable beta-cell abundance N with identity and proliferation controls

estimands.primary: Difference in F = D/N0 between edited and control challenged preparations at a prespecified late assessment
estimands.retained_abundance: S = N/N0, not a survival probability when proliferation or identity change occurs
estimands.survivor_quality: f = D/N for N > 0; descriptive among survivors, not an identified causal cell-intrinsic effect
estimands.challenge_interaction: Edited-control difference under challenge minus edited-control difference without challenge, separately by challenge type
estimands.joint: Within-preparation satisfaction of adequate output, acceptable basal release, regulated response and persistence criteria; estimate joint-success frequency and uncertainty against a justified benchmark and matched controls, not marginal mean tests alone. Add abundance or survivor-quality gates only for explicitly declared additional claims.
estimands.retention_references: Both matched edited/unchallenged and unedited/unchallenged preparations plus a separately specified responsive reference

required_calibrations_before_confirmator.null_meaning: Not determined by this paper; must be justified externally and fixed prospectively, not chosen to fit candidate results

minimum_abundance.required_for: A separately declared abundance acceptance claim, not a universal product-benefit gate

survivor_quality_noninferiority_margin.required_for: A separately declared per-survivor preservation claim

claims_and_dimensions.product_level_functional_immune_protecti: Sufficient regulated output under immune challenge with benefit supported by matched challenge comparisons over the specified period; no universal extra-retention or per-survivor noninferiority prerequisite
claims_and_dimensions.increased_retention: Separate live-abundance claim; investigate growth and identity transitions before assigning a survival mechanism
claims_and_dimensions.preserved_survivor_function: Separate claim tested against a biologically justified margin; failure does not automatically disqualify otherwise useful product output
claims_and_dimensions.compensated_output: Descriptive combination of greater retained abundance and lower per-survivor output; can overlap with per-survivor noninferiority when a modest reduction lies inside the justified margin
claims_and_dimensions.classification: Report the dimensions and claim-specific conclusions; they are not mutually exclusive outcome bins

calibration_pathway.sets: Biologically meaningful minimum output, acceptable basal behavior and duration; clinical utility requires clinical outcomes

calibration_pathway.basis: Independent responsive reference plus both matched unchallenged genotypes
calibration_pathway.sets: Expected basal/stimulated response profile and assay acceptance; prevents a weak edited baseline from defining success

calibration_pathway.basis: External functional or dose-response evidence and intended use
calibration_pathway.sets: Largest biologically acceptable loss for each preservation claim; assay noise does not set permissive biological margins

calibration_pathway.basis: Assay validation and pilot independent preparations and donors
calibration_pathway.sets: Repeatability, quantification limits, recovery, between-preparation variance, covariance, attrition and challenge stability; use these for precision and sample-size planning

calibration_pathway.basis: Manufacturing reliability, intended use and model kinetics
calibration_pathway.sets: Justified product-success frequency benchmark and late assessment times; lock all criteria and analysis before confirmatory results

measurement_settings.culture_or_perifusion: Estimate QL and QH from collected hormone amount per time with known volume or flow and source/background controls; calibrated live beta-cell counts permit N and f
measurement_settings.animal_or_clinical_graft: Circulating insulin/C-peptide concentrations and glycemia are functional readouts, not direct secretion rates; kinetics, clearance and source attribution need additional assumptions
measurement_settings.clinical_abundance: Usually not a direct whole-graft live-cell count; imaging/biopsy proxies cannot be silently substituted for N
measurement_settings.scope: Apply the identity only to commensurate quantities; state when measurements support proxies rather than direct F or f

failure_handling.complete_cell_loss: Zero viable-cell output, undefined survivor output; retain in total-output analysis
failure_handling.unresponsive_controls: Record product/assay failure; do not call a null edit contrast evidence of retained responsiveness
failure_handling.missing_assay: Missing, not automatically zero; analyze under declared missing-data sensitivity assumptions
failure_handling.death_during_secretion_assay: Use validated phase-specific cell-time denominators or invalidate per-survivor interpretation
failure_handling.early_benefit_late_loss: Delayed failure over the observed horizon, not durable protection

inference: Use donor- and preparation-aware paired models or cluster resampling. A single all-required intersection-union claim differs from simultaneous confidence coverage and from selection across edits or times.
subsequent_question: If single-edit results justify it, test a candidate-by-immune-intervention factorial design; do not assume complementary mechanisms or additive benefit.
clinical_boundary: Intermediate potency and immune-model success do not establish insulin independence, patient benefit or long-term product safety.
